draft_en.subject: A second ODM source for the InVid-branded PoE switches
draft_en.body:
Hi Joe,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 21 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the InVid-branded PoE switches that ship with your camera and NVR lines (Centro-built today), a second ODM source in your housing from small lots, FCC/CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $145.7. Web GUI with the InVid logo; colour box from 200 sets.

One question: which size would you dual-source first - the 8-port in the kits, or the 24-port for larger sites?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
